claim.title: How to Claim Your Diamonds
claim.intro: After completing your purchase, follow these steps to claim your diamonds:
claim.step1: Visit the Free Fire official website
claim.step2: Log in with your Free Fire account
claim.step4: Enter the code that will be sent to your email after purchase
claim.step5: Confirm the redemption and the diamonds will be added to your account

delivery.question: How long does it take to receive my diamonds?
delivery.answer: After completing your purchase, you will receive your redemption code via email within 5-10 minutes. In rare cases, it may take up to 24 hours during high traffic periods.

payment.question: What payment methods are accepted?
payment.answer: We accept various payment methods including bank transfers, card payments, and mobile money. All payments are processed securely through our payment partners.

refund.question: Can I get a refund?
refund.answer: Refunds are not available. Please contact our support team for assistance with refund requests.
